registration_stage: Before any v2 optimization steps or v2 development/target results
research_direction: Occluded RGB person ReID; model compression and lightweight design are not contributions
hypothesis: Occluder-appearance stability alone may retain identity-irrelevant evidence. Detached other-image identity margins may improve the reliability target. This is a falsifiable candidate, not an established mechanism or proven novel method.
split: Market training identities only: fixed seed 2026, 651 training IDs / 100 development IDs. 12 training identities have fewer than K=4 images (minimum 2). All variants use PeerPKSampler: visit every source once before replacement for these small pools. Targets exclude all copies of the anchor source and weight repeated peers inversely by multiplicity. No identity is dropped.
optimizer: Same recipe as v1: Adam AMSGrad, lr 0.0003, heads x5, weight decay 0.0005, first 2 epochs freeze backbone, cosine schedule, AMP, gradient clip 10.
loss: CE label smoothing 0.1 + 0.5 per-view batch-hard triplet + 0.5 calibration BCE + 0.5 surviving-evidence loss when enabled
primary_development_metric: (mAP synthetic_noise_0.3 + mAP synthetic_noise_0.5)/2, mean across both seeds

comparisons.paste3-repeat3: effect of donor-paste augmentation with matching image-view and optimizer budgets; repeat3 repeats the SAME transformed clean tensor, not three independent transforms
comparisons.peer-stability: replace appearance-stability target by peer identity target with the SAME reliability architecture
comparisons.peer_stability-peer: add the legacy appearance attenuation to peer target
comparisons.peer_evidence-peer_stability: add the explicitly reused v1 surviving-evidence consistency loss

external_plan: After all 12 development runs finish, freeze all checkpoint SHA256s in an immutable manifest, then evaluate ALL 12 on the same real Occluded-REID 1000-query/1000-gallery cross-dataset protocol. No selection, retry hyperparameter tuning, test-time augmentation or reranking. New runs are trained on 651 IDs, not directly comparable to older 751-ID/20-epoch rows.
external_prior_exposure: Old v1 Occluded-REID results have already been inspected. This is an exploratory transfer confirmation, not a newly unseen benchmark. Future paper claims need another independent occluded dataset.
decision_rule: Retain every signed result. Two seeds and 640 updates are a feasibility screen, not significance or convergence evidence. A synthetic-only gain does not establish occlusion generalization. Do not alter these hyperparameters after seeing v2 outcomes.
novelty_boundary: Discriminative and invariant region confidence already appear in RGANet (TIFS 2024). The candidate here is a detached leave-one-image-out visual identity margin surviving two controlled donor replacements as a spatial calibration target. General prototype learning, sigmoid, minimum, attention pooling, and consistency are not claimed as new.
source_preservation: Do not modify code/reid/*.py, code/train.py or vendored OSNet. New implementation uses independent occlusion_v2 package and entry points. Preserve all v1 records.
